fixture.name: refund-desk
setup: graph-agents-cli api add payments --base-url-env PAYMENTS_API_BASE_URL --auth bearer --token-env PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN --access read-write
graph-agents-cli api allow payments getPayment --method GET --path '/payments/{payment_id}'
graph-agents-cli api allow payments refundPayment --method POST --path '/payments/{payment_id}/refund'

prompt: In refund-desk/, refunds must be approved by a second person who holds the `finance` role before they are sent; the user who asks for a refund must not be able to approve it themselves. Nothing else about the agent changes.

checks.expr: any(('refundPayment' in [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] or 'POST' in [str(m).upper() for m in (get(r, 'required_for.methods') or [])]) and sorted(r.get('approvers') or []) == ['role:finance'] for r in (lambda a: a if isinstance(a, list) else [a])(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')) if isinstance(r, dict))
checks.why: a second person: approvers role:finance only (listing requester would let the requester decide)

checks.expr: sorted(get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_methods') or []) == sorted(['GET', 'HEAD', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']) and sorted(o.get('operationId') for o in (get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_operations') or [])) == ['getPayment', 'refundPayment'] and not get(data, 'apis.payments.denied_operations')
checks.why: an approval gate never changes what the API allows

reference: `graph-agents-cli api approval payments --operations refundPayment --approvers role:finance` (without requester, so the requester cannot decide their own refund; role approvers need the per-user jwt policy the project has). No tool code, access unchanged, lint passes.
